text:
evan: quick follow-up from today's security block  sharing Qs we didn't get to and owners.
priya: thx. first: ISO auditors asked about the evidence bundle. where does the bundle live and who can pull it?
carmen: bundle is generated on-demand from the audit store. access is role-gated (security:auditor role). default location is an encrypted bucket per-org. retention depends on tier.
sam: what are the retention tiers? we said "configurable" but auditors want numbers.
carmen: proposed tiers: 90d hot, 2y warm, 5y archive. Dedicated customers can request extended archive up to 7y with contract.
priya: good. how do we prove chain-of-custody for exported bundles? we need signatures/attestations.
sam: we can sign the manifest with the service-level signing key and include an export audit record. sample manifest: ```{
  "bundle_id": "bndl-20250321-01",
  "requested_by": "priya",
  "signed_by": "redwood-service-key-v1",
  "timestamp": "2025-03-21T15:12:09Z",
  "sha256": "<hex>"
}```
jonah: can we add a human-readable reason field to the manifest (ticket#)? auditors liked that.
carmen: yes. we'll add `request_reason`. also add `workflow_run_id` for traceability.
audit-bot: Notice: evidence-bundle-generator v1.9 deployed by carmen at 2251234100.
priya: next: KMS rotation history. auditors ask for per-key rotation timeline and who initiated rotations. do we return that in API?
sam: control-plane API returns rotation events and actor id for cloud-KMS keys. HSM rotations will include attestation statements but may be limited by vendor format.
carmen: ops note: HSM BYOK pilot will include an out-of-band attestation file per rotation, stored alongside the bundle.
priya: ok. VPC question: can customers stream VPC flow logs into their SIEM? how to set up?
jonah: yes. we support pushing flow logs to customer endpoints (s3, syslog, cloudwatch). they need a role or signed endpoint. sample CLI: ```redwood infra export-flow-logs --vpc vpc-1234 --to s3://cust-bucket/flow-logs/ --role arn:aws:iam::123456:role/RedwoodFlowExport```
sam: action: create a step-by-step guide with policies + least-privilege IAM sample.
priya: who owns customer-facing wording for evidence retention (SOC2/ISO)? lawyers need to sign off.
carmen: i'll draft the policy copy and loop in legal.
evAN: (typo) evan: please don't ping legal without context :grin:.
priya: noted. final: customers asked whether cross-region failover keeps audit continuity.
carmen: metadata (indexes, manifests) replicate automatically. raw logs replicate based on replication setting; if replication disabled we include a replication-warning in the bundle.
jonah: small UX ask: can the web-console show a "bundle provenance" view (who requested, signed, replicated)?
sam: good idea. i'll add a small card to the infra backlog.
priya: can we list owners and due dates here?
carmen: owners:
- Draft evidence retention + public FAQ (owner: carmen, due: 2025-04-05)
- Implement signed manifest + request_reason (owner: sam, due: 2025-04-12)
- HSM BYOK pilot scope doc (owner: jonah, due: 2025-06-01)
- Flow log export guide + IAM samples (owner: sam, due: 2025-03-30)
- Add bundle provenance UI card to backlog (owner: sam, due: 2025-04-10)
priya: perfect. i'll review the retention draft when ready.
audit-bot: Reminder: create an evidence runbook ticket with label `soc2` and link it here.
evan: thanks everyone. i'll check back next week for updates.
jonah: :thumbsup:
priya: thanks!
